principle: Elapsed time changes routing only, never truth, evidence, or authority. A time-based escalation requests a decision from a higher owner; it never silently enlarges the escalating actor's authority. No blocker remains inert or ownerless past its SLA.

classes.hazard: An unresolved technical ambiguity, ownership contest, or integration question stalls reversible work.
A cross-domain data contract is unsafe and the Data Architecture lead has withheld it.
The deputy has held custody of a blocker past its resolution window without entered work.
An owner-exclusive, safety, credential, irreversible, or intent-conflict decision is required.

rules.acyclic_route: Each route is an ordered list of actor_ids with no repeats; it must terminate at the Owner or a role that itself routes to the Owner.
rules.authority_effect_fixed: authority_effect must be request-decision for every class; escalation never grants authority.
